description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named SearchViewFilterMode. The activity displays a searchable list of cheese names that can be filtered in real-time using a SearchView widget. It sets up the UI components, integrates search query handling, and filters the list based on user input.

classes.name: SearchViewFilterMode
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of cheese names filtered using a SearchView widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up the SearchView and ListView components.

methods.name: setupSearchView
methods.description: Configures the SearchView widget with filtering behavior, query text listener, and hint.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles real-time text changes in the search query to filter the list view.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submission of the search query; here it does nothing and returns false.
